parsed.note_claim: Reports and footage confirm the retreat and surrender of pro-Saudi Yemeni government (PLC) forces in Hodeidah and Taiz provinces, including Mokha and Hays.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: * Houthis capture [[Hanish Islands]], [[Hays district|Hays]] and [[Al Khawkhah district]]s in [[Al-Hudaydah Governorate]] and [[Mokha]] and [[Dhubab district]]s in [[Taiz Governorate]]
parsed.reason: The page confirms Houthis captured the specific locations (Hays, Mokha, Taiz, Hudaydah) mentioned in the note from the PLC side, substantiating the claim about the forces and territories involved.
